summary: Kiti Panit is an updated Lanna restaurant in a restored 1888 teak mansion on Tha Phae Road, Chiang Mai. It suits a shared regional meal with the setting as part of the experience; the online menu has familiar khao soi as well as northern relishes, salads, curries and grilled dishes.
whyGo: A historic general-store mansion and locally rooted cooking make the meal distinctive beyond the food alone.
The menu gives a group room to sample northern specialties, from fermented tea-leaf salad and relishes to hung lay pork curry and khao soi.
bestFor: Travellers who want a comfortable sit-down introduction to Lanna food and are happy to share several dishes.
Couples or small groups looking for a central, atmospheric lunch or dinner.
skipIf: You need confirmed step-free access or accessible toilets; the available sources do not establish these details for the historic building.
You need a guaranteed vegan, halal or allergen-safe meal and cannot confirm ingredients and cross-contact directly.
duration: Allow about 60–90 minutes for a meal; this is a planning estimate, and a busy evening may take longer.
cost: The current menu lists dishes such as nam prik relishes at ฿190, chicken khao soi at ฿260 and hung lay pork curry at ฿390; rice is ฿35. Menu prices exclude 10% service charge and 7% VAT. A shared meal with one starter, two mains and rice is roughly ฿900–฿1,200 for two before drinks, depending on choices; this is a planning estimate, not a set menu.
hours: The restaurant currently lists Wednesday–Monday, lunch 11:30–15:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00, last order 21:30. Closed Tuesday. Recheck for December holiday changes.
bestTime: Lunch or an early dinner offers an easier-paced meal. Reserve ahead for dinner and weekends, especially around the December holiday period.
gettingThere: At 19 Tha Phae Road, central Chiang Mai, near Tha Phae Gate and the Sunday Walking Street area. The Japan National Tourism Organization lists it as about a 10-minute walk from Tha Phae Gate. For longer trips across town, a taxi or ride-hail to the street address is practical; fares and current public-transport routes were not verified.
booking: The Michelin Guide says the restaurant manages its own bookings. Contact Kiti Panit directly at +66 80 191 7996 or contact@kitipanit.com; the official site also links online ordering. Confirm the reservation and holiday hours with the restaurant.
accessibility: Air conditioning is listed by Michelin, but step-free entry, stairs, accessible toilets and mobility access within the old mansion were not confirmed. Ask the restaurant directly if these affect your visit.
practicalTips: For a first shared order, consider a relish or fermented tea-leaf salad, one khao soi, hung lay moo, a vegetable side and rice; adjust the number of dishes to appetite.

There are some vegetarian-suitable choices on the menu, including fried vegetarian spring rolls and vegetable relishes, but confirm fish sauce, shrimp paste, egg and cooking fats with staff. A clearly vegan or halal selection was not established.
Tell staff about allergies before ordering and ask about ingredients and kitchen cross-contact; no allergy protocol was verified.
The official menu says all prices exclude both 10% service charge and 7% VAT, so budget above the listed item prices.
decemberNotes: This is a year-round restaurant rather than a seasonal event. December 2026 holiday hours and menu/prices are not published in the sources checked; reserve directly and reconfirm opening times, menu and prices close to your visit.
uncertainties: Menu prices and availability may change before December 2026.
Step-free access, accessible toilet provision, detailed dietary accommodations and allergy cross-contact practices are unverified.
The official site provides current hours, but special holiday schedules may differ.
The linked official photo is a venue reference; reuse permission is not established.
